You've come to hear what I have to say.
You're the second to mention it, after Asma.
strings.자네는 모르겄지만, 정령들은 어떤 흐름에 따라 왔다 갔다 혀. 어쩌다 보: You may not know, but spirits come and go along certain currents. A few followed you all the way here.
strings.그 아이의 이야기를 들어보니 타르타로스의 샤이닉이란 아도 자네가 뭔가를: From what they tell me, that Shynic in Tartaros noticed you'd forgotten something, too.
The spirit that followed you says... because it was a bother.
Ah, that's Shynic. She wouldn't mention it if it was too much trouble.
strings.이야기하다 보니 궁금한 게 있어요. 사람들이 저의 어떤 표정을 보고 기억: That makes me wonder. What expression do people see that tells them I've lost memories?
strings.자네에게선 알 수 없는 공허함이 크게 느껴지는구먼. 마력이 강한 마법사나: There's a great, strange emptiness about you. Mages with strong mana and those with primal power notice it right away. That's why I spoke up.
strings.비어있는 느낌이 기억이 사라져서 나타나는 거라는 건가요?: So that empty feeling comes from missing memories?
strings.내 자네가 어떤 기억을 잃어버렸는지 알 수 없지만 말여. 그래도 기억을: I can't tell what memories you've lost. But I reckon I can help you recall them a little.
strings.내가 나이를 그냥 먹은 것은 아니니께. 자네 혹시 사이암이라는 자를 아는: I haven't lived all these years for nothing. Do you know someone named Siam? The one who defeated the Demon King with the goddess...
Oh, Siam... Yes, I know him.
strings.밤 하늘에 뜬 어떤 별들이 그가 있는 곳을 알려줬재. 바람의 정령을 그곳: Certain stars in the night sky showed me where he was. I sent wind spirits to hear his story, but it was no use.
strings.분명 우리 세계에 있는 것 같지만서도, 가려져 있는 그곳은 내가 어찌 할: He seems to be in our world, but that hidden place is beyond my reach.
strings.과거 세레스 여신께서 말씀하시길 기억은 시간과 공간이 함께 인식될 때 남: Goddess Seres once said memories remain when time and space are perceived together...
strings.어쩌면 말여. 사이암, 그가 있는 곳. 시간과 공간이 뒤틀린 곳에서 뭔가: Perhaps Siam, in that place where time and space are twisted, knows something...
strings.그가 있는 곳에 가면 될 것 같어. 공허함으로 가득 채워져 있는 공간에: Go where he is. That space filled with emptiness.
strings.정령에게 신뢰의 각인을 받은 인물을 위해 이 정도 도움을 주는 건 당연한: Helping someone marked with the spirits' trust is only natural. Go carefully, understood?
strings.그동안 얼마의 시간이 지났는지 이곳에선 도저히 느낄 수 없었소. 그래도: I cannot tell how much time has passed here. But your presence feels greatly changed. Time must have moved on.
Yes. A great deal has happened.
strings.(사이암에게 바나헤임의 일 이후 이리스를 만나기까지 무슨 일이 있었는지: (You explain to Siam what happened after Vanaheim and how you finally met Iris.)
After Vanaheim, I couldn't sense her presence. I was deeply worried. To think she was in a temple filled with divine power and received strength from the goddess residing there...
strings.이렇게라도 소식을 접해서 참 기쁘다고 생각했는데, 그래도 안타깝소. 여전: I'm glad to have news of her, even like this. Yet it saddens me. Her cruel fate seems to continue...
It's all right. Everything will work out. Don't worry too much.
Since you've come to see me here, something must be troubling you.
strings.(기억을 잃은 표정에 대한 것과 함께 정령 라피뎀이 이곳으로 가보라는 이: (You explain what people said about your expression and lost memories, and that the spirit Lapidem sent you here.)
strings.고마운 분이오. 날 인식하고 이곳으로 그댈 보내주셔서…. 내게도 그대의: How kind of him to perceive me and send you here... I can feel your emptiness, too. I don't know what it is. However...
I know a way that might awaken your memories, if only faintly.
strings.나에게 이 세계에서 위대했던 마법사 중 한 명의 도구를 하나 가져다주시오: Bring me a tool belonging to one of this world's great mages. The lingering thoughts within it may help...
Thank you, Siam. I'll be back.
strings.위대했던 마법사의 도구…. 사념에 남은 기운이 느껴지오. 위험한 건 아니: A great mage's tool... I can sense the energy in its lingering thoughts. It isn't dangerous. You needn't watch from so far away.
Oh, all right. I'll come closer.
strings.이 도구는 그대의 공허함을 채우기엔 상성이 맞지 않는 것 같소. 그래도: It doesn't seem compatible with filling your emptiness. But our efforts weren't fruitless. I read a brief memory.
strings.도구에서 마법사와 인연이 있던 한 소녀가 기억을 잃은 적이 있었는데, 다: The tool recalls a girl connected to the mage who once lost her memories. Fortunately, she seems to have recovered them.
strings.소녀에게서 그 방법을 알아내시오. 그대도 그 방법대로 한다면 잃어버린 기: Learn her method. If you follow it, you may recover your lost memories, too.
strings.(내가 아는 사람 중 그 마법사와 인연이 있던 사람이라면….): (Someone I know who was connected to that mage...)
strings.그리고 언제라도 좋으니 정령님께 감사를, 이리스 양에게는 안부를 전해주시: And when you can, please give my thanks to the spirit and my regards to Iris.
I will. Actually, perhaps you can greet Iris now.
strings.(이리스, 이리스. 혹시 듣고 있다면 목소릴 들려줘.): (Iris, Iris. If you can hear me, let us hear your voice.)
strings.괜찮소. 이곳까지 이리스 양의 메시지가 전달되려면 시간이 꽤 걸릴 것이오: It's all right. A message from Iris will take considerable time to reach this place.
strings.이리스 양이라면 훌륭한 권능으로 완벽한 여신이 될테니…. 반가웠소. 그대: She will become a perfect goddess with magnificent power... It was good to see you. May good fortune fill your days.
See you again, Siam. I'll be going.
strings.(%s의 모습이 사라지고 사이암이 마법사의 도구를 파괴하기 위해 손에 쥔: (Once %s disappears, Siam takes the mage's tool in hand to destroy it.)
...Hmm? Another person's memories remain. How unusual.
strings.이 도구에 다른 자의 기억이 남아있는 것 같은데…. 어떤 운명을 안고 이: There seem to be memories of someone else within this tool... An outsider who came to this world bearing a certain fate...
From the same world as me, or one much like it...
Why would someone once so righteous choose to become evil...?
strings.저기 너 말이야. 내가 분명 타르타로스에서 쉬고 있으라고 했을 텐데 어딜: You. I told you to rest in Tartaros, didn't I? Where have you been wandering?
Wait! I smell something. Sniff, sniff.
strings.보기 드문 힘을 가진 정령과 마법사를 만나고 온 모양이네? 그래도 나한테: You've met a spirit and a mage with unusual powers, haven't you? Still no match for me, though.
strings.두 사람을 만난 건 사실이지만, 샤이닉 님하고 싸울 생각은 없어요. 그: I did meet them, but I don't intend to fight you. I have a question instead.
What? If it's boring, I won't lift a finger.
An expression that suggests lost memories...
strings.분명 너는 기억을 잃은 적이 있어. 네 바보 같은 얼굴이 그걸 말해주고: You have definitely lost memories. Your silly face tells me so. An expression full of emptiness...
I thought you were just teasing me about my looks.
strings.난 그런 거로 장난치지 않아. 후후. 하여튼, 귀찮아서 신경 쓰지 않은: I wouldn't joke about that. Hehe. I simply didn't bother paying attention.
strings.그래서 무슨 기억을 잃어버렸는지 알고 싶다는 거야?: So you want to know what you've forgotten?
strings.그 기억이 어떤 내용인지 알고 싶다기보다는 기억을 회복할 방법을 알려주셨: Rather than what the memories contain, I'd like to know how to recover them.
But it might be fun, so I'll tell you. I owe you, too.
strings.예전 언제더라. 아, 맞다. 암흑 전쟁 중에 정신을 차리고 보니 내가 기: When was it...? Oh, right. During the Dark War, I came to covered in blood, with my memories gone.
strings.몇 개의 마을도 산산조각이 나서 난 거의 악마로 불렸었어. 그런데 기억이: Several villages lay in ruins. People practically called me a demon. But I couldn't remember anything.
strings.이게 다 그 영감탱이 때문…. 하여튼 보석나무 숲에 있던 고대용 글루아트: All because of that old bastard... Anyway, the ancient dragon Gluart in the Jewel Tree Forest helped me.
strings.보석나무의 열매라고 불리는 '빛의 눈물'을 이용해 기억을 찾을 수 있었어: I recovered my memories with 'Tears of Light,' called the fruit of the jewel trees. I don't know if you can still find them.
You'll need two. One won't do.
Thank you. I'll be right back.
strings.좋아. 재미있는 일이 될 테니까 기대해♡: Good. This should be fun. Look forward to it. ♡
strings.(윽…. 대체 뭘 기대하라는 거지.): (Urgh... What exactly am I supposed to look forward to?)
The Jewel Tree Forest isn't easy to enter. You managed well.
strings.샤이닉 님! 여기 빛의 눈물 구해왔어요!!: Shynic! I brought the Tears of Light!
Good work. Just as radiant and beautiful as they were back then.
strings.아마도 그때 내가 조금만 늦었어도 빛의 눈물에 대한 단서도 찾지 못했을: If I'd been a little later, I might never have found a clue about them.
strings.지스카드가 초인이 되자마자 고대룡 글루아트를 베어버렸거든. 인간에게 해가: As soon as Ziskad became a Champion, he slew the ancient dragon Gluart. He said he was destroying a threat to humanity, but...
No, never mind. Ask him yourself. Hehe.
strings.(뭔가 내가 모르는 이야기가 더 있는 것 같네.): (There's more to this that I don't know.)
strings.특별한 물건이라 정화가 필요할 거야. 안 그러면 탈이 날 테니까. 그럼: These are special. They need purification, or they'll cause trouble. Wait a moment.
strings.(샤이닉이 빛의 눈물을 손에 쥐고 눈을 감는다. 잠시 후, 손안에 있던: (Shynic holds the Tears of Light and closes her eyes. Soon the gems tremble in resonance with her mana.)
strings.먹어, 먹으라고. 못 들었어? 다시 한번 말해줄게. 삼켜♡: Eat them. Didn't you hear? I'll say it again. Swallow. ♡
Adventurer, taking them dry will be bad for you. I've brought water.
strings.자, 잠깐. 멜빅, 어디서 나타난 거죠?!: W-wait. Melvic, where did you come from?!
strings.(샤이닉과 멜빅 사이에 수상한 분위기가 감지된다.): (You sense something suspicious passing between Shynic and Melvic.)
strings.(샤이닉의 지시가 떨어지기 무섭게 멜빅이 %s의 뒤로 들어간다. 두 손이: (At Shynic's order, Melvic steps behind %s and seizes both hands. Struggling does little to loosen his grip.)
strings.자, 잠깐. 멜빅…. 뭐에요, 당신? 윽, 이 힘은… . 당신, 집사 아: W-wait. Melvic... What are you? Ugh, that strength... You're not a butler, are you?
strings.자, 아~하고 입 벌려. 여기 빛의 눈물. 먹기 좋게 정화했으니까 꼭: Open wide. Aah~ Here's a Tear of Light. I purified it to make it easy to eat, so you'd better swallow. Or I'll kill you. ♡
A-all right. I'll eat it. One first.
strings.(빛의 눈물 하나가 입안으로 들어간다. 의외로 식감이 쫄깃하고 독특한 향: (A Tear of Light enters your mouth. Surprisingly chewy, it releases a distinctive, refreshing aroma.)
strings.이건 마치…. 아, 음식평을 하고 있을 때가 아닌데. 바로 하나 더 먹어: It's just like... Wait, this isn't the time for food reviews. Better take the other one. Gulp.
...I ate them. Why does my head keep hurting...?
strings.(정신이 희미해졌다가 다시 깨끗해진다.): (Your mind grows hazy, then clear again.)
Only a mild headache. Good. I thought I was dying when I took them.
strings.그 기억의 크기만큼 고통도 심했다는 거야. 그래도 네가 잊은 기억의 크기: The pain matched the weight of the memories. Yours weren't such a large amount, it seems. Though that doesn't mean they were trivial.
Memories erased deliberately are usually important.
strings.자, 이제 깨닫는 것만 남았네? 내 몫은 여기까지. 나머진 다른 초인의: Now you only need to realize them. My part is done. Get help from the other Champions for the rest.
strings.신세 진 걸 갚은 것뿐이야. 여신의 망나니가 어디까지 가는지 그것도 보고: Just repaying a debt. I also want to see how far the Goddess's Executioner will go. Hehe. It was fun, so that's enough.
%s, Shynic says she had fun. How long it's been since I heard that... (Moved.)
Melvic, don't look so happy over this. It's embarrassing.
Then I'll return to my lodgings and rest. Call me when it's time.
strings.그래, 얼마 안 남았으니까 기대해♡: Soon enough. Look forward to it. ♡
strings.(으, 하나님. 제발 기대하지 말아주세요.): (Oh, God. Please don't look forward to this.)
